bookBlurbText: The book 'Stories About Not Being Afraid of Ghosts' is a collection of traditional Chinese ghost stories compiled by the Institute of Literature of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. It features tales centered around Chung Kuei, a famous figure in Chinese folklore known for his skill in catching ghosts. Translated by Yang Hsien-Yi and Gladys Yang, and illustrated by Cheng Shih-Fa, this volume explores the supernatural and folklore, offering readers a glimpse into the rich tradition of Chinese ghost stories.
